typedOptionsNeededFromRoot.name: Allow Non-Flow Ports To Switch Sides
typedOptionsNeededFromRoot.description: Specifies whether non-flow ports may switch sides if their node's port constraints are either FIXED_SIDE or FIXED_ORDER. A non-flow port is a port on a side that is not part of the currently configured layout flow. For instance, given a left-to-right layout direction, north and south ports would be considered non-flow ports. Further note that the underlying criterium whether to switch sides or not solely relies on the minimization of edge crossings. Hence, edge length and other aesthetics criteria are not addressed.

typedOptionsNeededFromRoot.name: Consider Model Order
typedOptionsNeededFromRoot.description: Preserves the order of nodes and edges in the model file if this does not lead to additional edge crossings. Depending on the strategy this is not always possible since the node and edge order might be conflicting.

branchFacts: calculateBarycenters first clears visited on every supplied current-layer node, then visits nodes in supplied order. Calculation returns immediately if already visited; otherwise marks visited before resetting own degree/summedWeight/barycenter.

A same-layer recursion cycle observes the partially computed visited state at that exact point. Do not solve a simultaneous equation, pre-mark a whole frontier, or reset already-visited state.

When degree is positive, perform exactly one nextInternal(24) RNG draw after all recursive children/associates. Add next24 * 2^-24 * 0.07000000029802322 - 0.03500000014901161 using that operation order, then divide by degree. Zero-degree state remains null and consumes no RNG.
